latestVersion.changelog:
Kling AI Image to Video — Version 1.0.0

- Initial release: convert still images (JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC, up to 20MB) into 1080p MP4 video clips using cloud AI.
- Simple prompts—e.g., “animate this image into a 5-second cinematic video clip.”
- Easy, credit-based anonymous authentication: auto-acquire free trial token if needed, no manual signup required.
- Comprehensive chat-driven workflow: upload, edit, preview, export, and check status or credits.
- Automated handling of file uploads, animation instructions, export/download, and error cases.
